001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.events.sd;
002
003import org.apache.log4j.Logger;
004
005import com.fs.starfarer.api.EveryFrameScript;
006import com.fs.starfarer.api.Global;
007import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.CampaignUIAPI;
008import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.SectorEntityToken;
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.econ.MarketAPI;
010import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.events.sd.SDDevastation.Stage;
011import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.events.sd.SDResolution.StandoffWinner;
012import com.fs.starfarer.api.util.Misc;
013
014public class SDRShowEndingScript implements EveryFrameScript {
015        public static Logger log = Logger.getLogger(SDResolution.class);
016        protected float daysLeft;
017        protected Boolean done = null;
018        protected StandoffWinner winner;
019        protected Stage devastation;
020        protected SectorEntityToken trigger;
021        protected float triggerRange;
022        
023        public SDRShowEndingScript(StandoffWinner winner, SDDevastation.Stage devastation, SectorEntityToken trigger, float triggerRange) {
024                this.winner = winner;
025                this.devastation = devastation;
026                
027                this.trigger = trigger;
028                this.triggerRange = triggerRange;
029                
030//              daysLeft = 0.3f;
031//              // give it a little time to simmer
032//              if(Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$cadenBlowsUpSindria")) {
033//                      daysLeft =  1.0f;
034//              }
035                daysLeft = 3f;
036                // give it a little time to simmer
037                if (Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$cadenBlowsUpSindria")) {
038                        daysLeft =  5.0f;
039                }
040        }
041
042        
043        public void advance(float amount) {
044                if (isDone()) return;
045                
046                float days = Global.getSector().getClock().convertToDays(amount);
047                daysLeft -= days;
048                
049                if (trigger != null) {
050                        if (trigger.isInCurrentLocation() && 
051                                        Misc.getDistance(Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet(), trigger) < triggerRange) {
052                                daysLeft = 0f;
053                        }
054                }
055                
056                if (daysLeft <= 0) {
057                        
058                        CampaignUIAPI ui = Global.getSector().getCampaignUI();
059                        if (ui.isShowingDialog()) {
060                                // this would spam the log as it happens every frame, it's just waiting for the UI to 
061                                // stop showing a dialog so it can show this one -am
062                                //log.info("aborting due to ui showing dialog?");
063                                return;
064                        }
065                        
066                        Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$supremeExecutorWinner", winner.name());
067                        Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$supremeExecutorDevastation", devastation.name());
068                        MarketAPI sindria = Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarket("sindria");
069                        if (sindria == null) {
070                                // something went badly wrong somewhere, just bail on this permanently
071                                done = true;
072                                // I think the Caden PK sequence is triggered by this very dialog so Caden would not
073                                // be the *cause* of this state -am
074                                //log.info("aborting due to null Sindria! CADENNNN!!");
075                                return;
076                        }
077                        
078                        boolean shown = Misc.showRuleDialog(sindria.getPrimaryEntity(), "SupremeExecutorFinished");
079                        if (shown) {
080                                done = true;
081                        } else {
082                                daysLeft = 0.0f + 0.3f * (float) Math.random();
083                        }
084                }
085        }
086        
087        public boolean isDone() {
088                return done != null && done == true;
089        }
090
091        public boolean runWhilePaused() {
092                return false;
093        }
094}
